naslov: Houston hosts Dallas in season opener
tekst:
Dallas Mavericks vs. Houston Rockets
              Houston; Wednesday, 8:30 p.m. EDT
              LINE: Rockets -8.5; over/under is 229.5
              BOTTOM LINE: The Houston Rockets start the season at home against the Dallas Mavericks.
              Houston went 52-30 overall and 10-6 in Southwest Division play last season. The Rockets averaged 115.2 points per game while allowing opponents to score 110.0 last season.
              Dallas went 26-56 overall and 4-12 in Southwest Division play during the 2025-26 season. The Mavericks averaged 114.1 points per game last season, 52.8 in the paint, 15.9 off of turnovers and 17.8 on fast breaks.
              INJURIES: Rockets: None listed.
              Mavericks: Dereck Lively II: out (foot), Santi Aldama: out (knee).
